baseline: No experimental labels for generated baseline candidates; arm-specific MAE/RMSE/correlation unavailable.
adaptive: No experimental labels for generated adaptive candidates; arm-specific MAE/RMSE/correlation unavailable.
external_evidence: Ridge and training-fold mean tested on the same strict grouped held-out pairs; zero target, exact-pair, or peptide-sequence overlap.
valid_conclusion: This compares prediction methods on the external dataset, not optimizer arms. Do not duplicate the same test metrics as two arm scores.

baseline: Prior exact-sequence audit: 0 exact PEPBI matches among 275 unique baseline candidate sequences.
adaptive: Prior exact-sequence audit: 0 exact PEPBI matches among 450 unique adaptive candidate sequences.
external_evidence: Strict matched PEPBI benchmark: native-score group concordance 0.3762 (11 groups); Rosetta 0.3927 (11 groups), target-calculated ΔG from Kd. Target-reported ΔG analysis has only 1 independent group.
valid_conclusion: Score-method comparison is possible on PEPBI. Candidate-arm experimental accuracy is not estimable without measured labels for those sequences.

baseline: The native sequence-only score has no receptor input; it cannot change with receptor context for a fixed baseline peptide.
adaptive: The same limitation applies to every fixed adaptive peptide sequence.
external_evidence: Prior control: native score unchanged in 24 matched receptor-variant pairs; 7 pairs had experimental ΔG differences >0.5 kcal/mol.
valid_conclusion: This demonstrates receptor-context blindness of the native score, not successful receptor-aware prediction. Candidate-level structural comparison remains unavailable without valid complex poses.

baseline: 12.08% of baseline mutation events fall at proxy positions [14, 3, 8].
adaptive: 19.61% of adaptive mutation events fall at the same proxy positions [14, 3, 8].
external_evidence: Shared external context-adjusted effect for these positions: -0.08283; random-position permutation p=0.54948. Separate all-pairs window test for positions 1–3: centered effect -0.01150, two-sided p=0.92182.
valid_conclusion: Arm mutation frequencies differ, but the external test did not validate the proxy positions. The proxies must not be described as verified ARISE-selected hotspots.

baseline: No exact candidate-to-experimental pKd matches in the previous paired-arm audit; per-arm measured-affinity accuracy unavailable.
adaptive: No exact candidate-to-experimental pKd matches in the previous paired-arm audit; per-arm measured-affinity accuracy unavailable.
external_evidence: 129 eligible measurement rows; 67 distinct peptides; 73 measurement contexts; within-context mean Spearman -0.4872. Only 9 informative single-substitution pairs; direction accuracy 1/9 = 11.11%.
valid_conclusion: Shared retrospective score-validity test, not an adaptive-versus-baseline accuracy test.

baseline: No exact candidate-to-experimental pKd matches in the previous paired-arm audit; per-arm measured-affinity accuracy unavailable.
adaptive: No exact candidate-to-experimental pKd matches in the previous paired-arm audit; per-arm measured-affinity accuracy unavailable.
external_evidence: 693 matched pairs; Spearman Δscore versus ΔpKd -0.10714 (95% CI [-0.20220, -0.01755]); informative-pair direction accuracy 42.49% (95% CI [36.55%, 47.77%]).
valid_conclusion: The shared benchmark argues against treating native C-score as a reliable experimental-affinity predictor. It does not establish which optimizer arm is more accurate experimentally.

baseline: No candidate-run PDBs available in the prior audit; candidate structural score comparison unavailable.
adaptive: No candidate-run PDBs available in the prior audit; candidate structural score comparison unavailable.
external_evidence: Prior structural benchmark scored 18 verified mapped pairs; Δscore versus ΔpKd rho 0.05882, p=0.81665; direction accuracy 50%.
